headline: AIM signed off for good on December 15, 2017.
slides: AOL Instant Messenger launched as its own download for Windows.
You could see who was online. You'd stay up just to see one name pop in.
Song lyrics, inside jokes, vague posts about someone. The first status updates.
In the early 2000s it ruled US messaging with tens of millions of users.
AOL announced the shutdown in October 2017. On December 15 the servers went dark.
AOL's farewell mentioned the CD, your first screen name and your carefully curated away messages.
sources: Sources: CBS News, CNBC, PCWorld, MacRumors (2017)
